en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a landscaped public park with formal flowerbeds and walking paths. At the center stands an octagonal pavilion or garden café with decorative wooden trim and a small finial on the roof. To the left is a large marble statue group on a pedestal with a low basin around it. Several people in late‑19th‑century or early‑20th‑century clothing stroll along the paths or stand under the trees lining the background.
